context.title: California Taxpayers Association (CalTax): positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: California — Proposition 3 (Provides Permanent Funding for Schools and Health Care by Extending Existing Tax on High Incomes)

positions.statement: Robert Gutierrez (President) signed the argument against Proposition 3 in the official voter guide.

subject.title: California — Proposition 4 (Repeals Prohibition Against Public Funding of Election Campaigns)

positions.statement: Robert Gutierrez (President) signed the rebuttal to the argument in favor of Proposition 4 in the official voter guide.

subject.title: California — Proposition 40 (Imposes One-Time Tax on Certain Taxpayers)

positions.statement: Rob Gutierrez (President) signed the rebuttal to the argument in favor of Proposition 40 in the official voter guide.

subject.title: California — Proposition 41 (Prohibits New State Taxes That Exclude Revenues from State Spending Limit. Requires Audits for New State Special Taxes)

positions.statement: Robert Gutierrez (President) signed the argument in favor of Proposition 41 and the rebuttal to the argument against Proposition 41 in the official voter guide.

subject.title: California — Proposition 43 (Limits Voters' Ability to Raise Revenues for Local Government Services)

positions.statement: Robert Gutierrez (President) signed the argument in favor of Proposition 43 in the official voter guide.
